title: Riverton approves four-day work week pilot for city staff
body: The Riverton City Council voted 7-2 on Tuesday to launch a one-year pilot of a four-day work week for its 1,200 municipal employees. Starting in January, staff will work four 10-hour days with no change in pay. Libraries and permit offices will stay open five days a week through staggered schedules. Supporters cited easier recruitment and reduced burnout, while critics warned of overtime costs and slower response times. The city will publish productivity and resident-satisfaction data every quarter.
